description: This Java source file defines the ReloadingX509TrustManager class, which implements an X509TrustManager that automatically reloads its truststore configuration when the truststore file on disk changes. It includes methods for managing the truststore, checking trust for clients and servers, and periodically reloading the truststore in a background thread.

classes.name: ReloadingX509TrustManager
classes.description: A trust manager that reloads its truststore configuration when the truststore file on disk changes, running in a background thread.

methods.name: ReloadingX509TrustManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trust manager with truststore details and starts the reloader thread.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Starts the background thread that periodically checks and reloads the truststore.

methods.name: getReloadInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval in milliseconds between reload checks.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the client certificate chain is trusted.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the server certificate chain is trusted.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns the list of accepted issuer certificates.

methods.name: needsReload
methods.description: Determines if the truststore needs to be reloaded based on file changes.

methods.name: loadTrustManager
methods.description: Loads the truststore and creates an X509TrustManager instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Background thread method that periodically checks and reloads the truststore if needed.
